profile_text.body:
Bark Technologies describes itself as a provider of parental controls for families. According to its site, the product helps parents monitor social media, manage screen time, and track location, and once connected, the company says its AI scans text, images, video, and audio for potential dangers, including conversations in English, Spanish, and Afrikaans, and sends alerts for anything concerning. The company also says its content monitoring scans messages, posts, comments, replies, and web searches, and that parents receive a timely alert when something concerning is found.

The company's tracked product is Bark for Schools, listed under education and research AI. It is described as monitoring of Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 for student safety, aimed at district administrators using school accounts. The note records that this entry came from research for The AI Ready School and was not independently verified, that it was found on a vendor comparison page only, and that privacy and price were not verified.

No lawsuits, SEC filings, patents, or MCP servers appear in the available material.
